The woman applies a clear liquid serum from a glass dropper to her face, then follows with a white cream, gently massaging them into her skin. (3) A close-up shot of the woman's hand holding a glass bottle labeled 'AVENE HYALURON ACTIV B3'. She uses the dropper to place a single drop of clear serum onto her hand, showcasing its texture. (4) The woman returns to the initial room setting. She touches her cheek again, highlighting the reflective, hydrated quality of her skin. She is expressive, using hand gestures to emphasize her points. (5) A close-up shot of an open white jar containing a thick white cream. The camera focuses on the texture of the product inside the jar. (6) The woman is back on screen in a medium close-up, continuing her explanation. She smiles frequently and tilts her head to show the glow on her skin under the bright indoor lighting. (7) A final shot shows two hands holding the Avene serum bottle and the cream jar together against the background of the room, presenting the full set of products.
